basics.type: Private college group set up in 2003 by the Siddhartha Educational Society
basics.ugc: Law approved by the Bar Council of India, pharmacy by the Pharmacy Council of India, nursing recognised by the Uttarakhand Nursing Council
basics.campus: Danda-Khudanewala, near IT Park, Sahastradhara Road, Dehradun
basics.other: Siddhartha Law College (BA LL.B., BBA LL.B., LL.B., LL.M.), Siddhartha Institute of Pharmacy (D.Pharm, B.Pharm, M.Pharm) and Siddhartha Nursing Education & Research Institute (B.Sc Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc, GNM)

admission: As per the affiliating university's rules

scholarships.text: Merit scholarships of 15% to 100% of tuition on Class 12 marks for law and pharmacy, with concessions for girls, siblings, wards of defence personnel and Uttarakhand domicile students.

hostel.text: Separate boys' and girls' hostels on campus with wardens, Wi-Fi, CCTV, 24/7 security, laundry and study rooms.

fees.text: SGI lists fees course-wise. Ask us for the current fee for your course.
